title: New SignDrop Zero-Day Exploit Turns Windows CLFS Security Feature Into SYSTEM Access
summary: Public exploit code released earlier this week claims that a local Windows user can gain SYSTEM privileges through the Common Log File System driver. The proof of concept, called SignDrop, targets a log-authentication feature added to the driver last year. It abuses how clfs.sys creates companion files when a privileged process opens a prepared log...
advisory: Urgent: Patch edge devices and review perimeter telemetry immediately.
